name: Wayfarer-class APC (AW-8A, Tally RWS)

scale.label: 1:56 (30 mm heroic vehicle scale)
scale.note: True 1:56 from concepts/wayfarer-apc (8.43 m long). Only printing-driven exaggerations (see exaggerations).

frame: mm at 1:56, x = vehicle front, y = vehicle left, z up, ground z = 0

hull.split_note: Plane cut at x = -11.5 through the RWS ring footprint (ring centre x = 0, seat radius 15.2): the turntable covers the roof seam for |y| < 9.6, the side seam falls in the applique-plate gap and a 0.7 x 0.45 mm panel-line groove runs round the rest.
hull.wall_note: 1.8 mm (brief '~2 mm'): R2 resin pass. Owner can set 2.0 here; the kit then grows ~4-5 ml.

wheels.tread_note: Owner default: chunkier sci-fi tread (14 staggered chamfered blocks per shoulder, 1.0 mm proud). Non-directional so one identical part fits all 8 stations (a directional chevron would point backwards on one side).

hatches.note: M5/M5R: openings sized to pass every measured Vigil figure lengthwise (reports/build.json fit.min_hatch_opening_mm); long axis along the hull; 1.9 mm from the ring collar, 1.0 mm between rows.

benches.note: x0 = split_x - 3 pitches so a back-pad gap falls on the split (M6: a pad crossing it left a 0.2 mm sliver).

exaggerations: RWS heavy-repeater barrel 2.0 mm (real ~70 mm cooled jacket would be 1.25 mm): thickened to clear the 0.6 mm unsupported-wall rule and survive handling.
Smoke-discharger tubes 1.8 mm (real 76 mm tubes = 1.36 mm).
Antenna replaced by a 1.2 mm stub with a ball tip (a 0.35 mm whip fails the wire table); fit brass rod for a long whip.
Panel lines and lens slots 0.5-0.7 mm wide, 0.4-0.5 mm deep (engraved limit 0.4 mm) so a wash finds them.
Tread blocks 1.0 mm proud (about 56 mm real): owner default 'chunkier tread'.
owner_assumptions: Amphibious kept as lore: two stern waterjets under the sponsons and a trim vane folded flat on the glacis (concept question 1).

Heroic licence on bench width: ten exosuited Vigilants on two benches of five in a 3.26 m hull; seat pitch 18.6 mm (1.04 m), aisle 40 mm; the bay is 23.7 mm (1.33 m) clear, so troopers board crouched (door 22.0 mm clear passes a 65 % crouch of every measured Vigilant) and sit stooped (concept question 2).
True 1:56, not a compressed heroic vehicle scale (concepts/README open question).

catalog.revision_note: resin kit: split hollow hull, 8 wheels, Tally RWS on the 30 mm ring, ramp, 4 hatches
catalog.base: none: stands on its eight wheels
catalog.description: The Aster Compact's road-and-river battle taxi at 1:56: a deep-V blast-chevron hull with tumblehome sides, keel crest up the long glacis, six alternating applique plates a side, eight chunky-tread wheels on D-flat axle stubs and a Tally remote weapon station that drops onto the shared 30 mm magnetised ring. The stern ramp and four roof hatches are separate, so it can be built buttoned up or deploying its section.

images.label: 3/4 front with a Vigilant for scale (render)

buildNotes: Hull prints as two hollow halves (1.8 mm walls) split at x = -11.5 under the RWS ring; each half prints standing on its split face, so the mating faces are flat and the show faces carry no supports (only internal supports under the glacis / stern ceilings). Glue with two of the three printed D-flat split pins (or 3 mm rod).

Drains: 3.5 mm keel holes at x -60 and +40, a 3.5 mm hole on the split line at the keel and at the roof spine (half in each part; it vents the cavity while printing), a roof vent under the turntable; the hatch openings and the stern door also drain the bay.
Wheels: one part, print 8. Each hub has a 3.2 mm D-flat socket that only fits its axle stub one way round.
Tally RWS: glue a 5 x 2 mm magnet in the turntable underside and one in the hull ring seat (mark polarity); the RWS turns freely and swaps with the Palisade's ring tops.
Stern ramp: the hinge pins drop into open-top slots in the two stern cheeks; glue closed, or open at 122 deg so the lip rests on the table. Hatches plug into their coamings closed, or glue open.

Embark matrix at true 1:56 (reports/fit.md, measured figure envelopes, 0.5 mm clearance a side): rifleman, rifleman Mk2, heavy and warden board through the stern door crouched (door 26 x 23.7 mm) and pass a roof hatch lengthwise (24.5 x 16.8 mm); the marksman's 31 mm rifle passes neither (embark it as a token). No figure stands in the 1.33 m bay; the ten seats are for stooped troopers.
catalog.limitations: Procedural CSG model (manifold3d), not a hand sculpt: crisp facets, no weld beads or tool stowage. Capacity at true 1:56: seats 10 stooped (bay 1.33 m clear), no standing room; the open ramp is a deploy point for based figures and a crouched Vigilant clears the door (reports/fit.md). STEP export skipped (FreeCAD not installed in this environment). Printability is a heuristic screen through unified-CAD-MCP, not a test print; print a ring/peg tolerance coupon first.

drains_note: Keel drains at x -60 and 40; a 3.5 mm hole on the split plane at the keel and at the roof spine (half in each part, a vent at layer 0 in the print pose); a roof vent at (-6, 7) under the turntable (moved off the centreline in M6: it was tangent to the split-plane vent, 1 non-manifold edge).
